evidence: Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules in src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp and src/validation.cpp, covering difficulty adjustment constraints, coinbase height timelocks, legacy sigop limits, and 64-byte transaction invalidation.
rationale: This PR provides the consensus engine implementation for BIP 54, resolving long-standing vulnerabilities including timewarp attacks, 64-byte Merkle tree collisions (CVE-2017-12842), and legacy sigop CPU exhaustion. Because it is configured for regtest testing without immediate mainnet activation, delay does not present an urgent release-cycle emergency, but deliberating and validating the consensus logic provides substantial and durable strategic value.
